common_prompt: Generate ONE isolated reusable game UI RESOURCE PNG, NOT a mockup, NOT a spritesheet, NOT a screenshot. The attached image is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match its pixel-art UI frame vocabulary precisely. This is a Korean 2D fantasy incremental RPG. Dark charcoal-plum interior (#15111e), crisp dark-purple outer outline, restrained aged-brass/gold double border, stepped square-pixel corners with tiny diamond notches, 2-3 shade pixel bevels. Hand-placed crisp square pixels, consistent 32-bit-era RPG pixel scale, no antialiased vector edges, no smooth metallic rendering, no blurring. Straight flat edges and a calm almost-flat center, so the art can later be nine-sliced. No text, no letters, no numbers, no icons, no illustrations, no symbols in the interior, no drop shadows outside the art, no cast lighting, no backdrop. Transparent background outside the isolated resource with modest even transparent padding on all sides. Do not show a checkerboard as image content. Keep borders proportional and slim like the reference. No gigantic medieval ornaments. One asset only, centered and fully visible.
usage: Integrated into runtime UI. Initial prompt is common_prompt + prompt_suffix. For revised assets, see edits for subsequent full edit prompts and current_generated_path.
